verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that AI Gateway exposes OpenAI Chat Completions endpoints and that existing OpenAI client libraries can switch over with a URL change and no code rewrites. An AI Gateway API key handles authentication, which covers the key half of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of drop-in compatibility, and documentation of any parity gaps beyond Chat Completions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible code at the gateway by changing only the base URL and key

citations.quote: You can use existing OpenAI client libraries, switch to AI Gateway with a URL change, and keep your current tools and workflows without code rewrites.
Point your existing client to the AI Gateway's base URL
Point your existing OpenAI or Anthropic SDK at AI Gateway. Same calls, no rewrites.
Use an AI Gateway API key or OpenID Connect (OIDC) token.
